description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Vantive is a vital organ therapy company developing solutions to improve kidney care and other vital organ therapies. The Embedded Software Engineer will contribute to the development and maintenance of embedded software for PrisMax medical systems, supporting design, implementation, testing, verification, cybersecurity, and sustaining engineering throughout the product lifecycle.
Embedded medical-device software engineer developing, testing, and maintaining regulated platform software

Responsibilities:
• Design, implement, and maintain embedded software features and enhancements for the PrisMax platform
• Support software development activities from requirements through implementation, integration, verification, release, and sustaining engineering
• Participate in software architecture discussions, design reviews, and code reviews
• Develop unit tests and support automated testing initiatives
• Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve software defects using structured root cause analysis techniques
• Collaborate with systems engineers to understand product requirements and maintain traceability between requirements, design, implementation, and testing
• Support risk management activities including hazard analysis and software-related mitigations
• Assist with software verification and validation activities in compliance with medical device regulations and standards
• Work closely with electrical and systems engineering teams to diagnose hardware/software integration issues
• Contribute to cybersecurity, reliability, and performance improvements across the platform
• Support design history file (DHF) documentation and engineering deliverables required within a regulated development environment
• Participate in Agile planning, estimation, and sprint execution activities

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related technical discipline
• 0- 2+ years of engineering experience, including internships, co-ops, or academic projects
• Proficiency in C++ and/or C
• Understanding of embedded software fundamentals including: Real-time systems Microcontrollers and processors Hardware/software interfaces Debugging techniques Communication protocols
• Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving skills
• Strong written and verbal communication skills
• Ability to work effectively in a collaborative, multidisciplinary engineering team

Preferred:
• Experience with RTOS-based development or embedded Linux
• Familiarity with ARM-based processors and embedded development tools
• Exposure to communication protocols such as SPI, I2C, UART, CAN, USB, or Ethernet
• Experience with Git and modern software development workflows
• Knowledge of Python or scripting languages used for test automation
• Familiarity with automated testing frameworks and CI/CD concepts
• Understanding of cybersecurity concepts for connected medical devices
• Exposure to regulated industries such as medical devices, aerospace, automotive, or industrial controls
